learning_outcomes.text: Needed knowledge and skills for engineering practice in area application of basic principles of sanitary installations with concentrated on gas, water and canalization pipe systems.

syllabus_topics: Installation influence to lay-out solution and to architecture
Building water main design
Building connection to public water main
Inner canalization design and house drains
Domestic waste water
Storm sewer
Inner gas conduit design
Low-pressure and middle-pressure gas fixtures
Gas apparatuses
Main water piping - analysis water demand
Calculation distribution water piping
Examples connecting and wiring water piping
Prepare domestic hot water - calculation warm service water demand
Project of circulation piping
Public sewer - project sewers
Examples projects and connection houses on public sewer
Sanitary pipe work - project of sanitary pipe work
Project of drain roof
Gas engineering - project of gas fixture
Project and locating of gas meter and gas regulator
Gas apparatus - project of gas apparatus
Project of flue gas ducting
